sourceText: The global proof-or-stop points at another worktree / is unreliable every session; worth scheduling in the same batch. Write a RED/GREEN proof, create the story, develop it through the normal process until DONE (user, 2026-09-02).
normalizedOutcome: The global proof-or-stop executable keeps working after every dist rebuild, and doctor reports global-executable realpath/mode drift with an exact remediation.
acceptanceClaim: packages/main/tests/red/red-global-cli-exec-bit.mjs exits 0 in the story worktree (build pipeline restores the bin executable bit; tsc-emitted 0644 bin target becomes 0755 after promotion) while it still exits 1 against the unfixed main checkout.
